mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, it is 56 degrees under clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, and we are currently seeing a Waning Gibbous moon.

The Plan Commission is reviewing multiple development projects including a new site plan at 201 South Main Street and various survey maps throughout the town. Additionally, the city has been busy with community initiatives like the recent sticker design contest and park improvements.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown farmer's market, yoga, or live music and pizza.
On September 21, officers investigated a retail theft where a subject was identified stealing Swedish Fish candy and subsequently cited.
Today's featured flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, which is sure to be a hit. The shop opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
